entries.name: Eric
entries.blurb: Last undefeated and 2nd in scoring. Gotta be in the top spot. Roster depth could use a little work but the stars are there with Lamar, JSN, McBride. Zurg zurging so far

entries.name: Kevans
entries.blurb: Leads the league in scoring and sitting at 4-1. Jahmyr Gibbs is the best player in fantasy and the team doesn't really have any weak spots. Strong contender

entries.name: Sam
entries.blurb: Sitting strong at 4-1. K9, Josh Allen, are carrying this team so far and only loss was with Walker on bye. Pickens shoud have better games ahead too. Rb room a little thin but another good team

entries.name: Niall
entries.blurb: Bijan, Rhamondre, Nabers, rashee rice all have high upside and the qbs are sneaky good. Probably a playoff team

entries.name: Malin
entries.blurb: sitting at 2-3 and needs to get some wins soon but the roster still looking fine. Needs Breece hall to come back, maybe tyreek to sign soon. But Jamar chase and the great Brock purdy keep the team dangerous

entries.name: Logan
entries.blurb: A surprise being this high at 1-4 but has been getting reemed with the most points scored against by far… But I think the wins are coming. The roster is still looking ok….Maybe josh jacobs comes back for a late season run?

entries.name: Chris
entries.blurb: Better days are ahead for this team I think. Charbonnet, saquon, Jordyn Tyson, Makai lemon have all done nothing so far and should all get healthy as some point. Expect this team to push for a playoff spot. Very deep WR room...could be a nice team to trade with

entries.name: Roldan
entries.blurb: Getting close to desperation times for the teams down here. The rookie rbs have NOT worked out thus far for Ocean Dan. Havent seen much mention of Jadarian Price in the chat lately. Maybe the late season turn around comes for Price, Love and Waddle? Don't see it coming though

entries.name: Grant
entries.blurb: If season ended today would be a playoff team (Couple lucky wins so far to improve is luck rating even more) But this team is  pretty stinky and Jalen Hurts has blood clots now? Think things get tougher going forward for this squad

entries.name: Hugh
entries.blurb: Very dissapointing start for Hughbert. But still have Puka and Ceedee who can go off and win weeks. Need to find something at RB with Hampton looking like a bust.

entries.name: Beef
entries.blurb: The Greasings are not good. But got a W and maybe Marvin Harrison breaks out with his old friend CJ stroud after pulling a James Harden and sucking his way into a trade. And Jamo, Jefferson and Mahomes and have explosive weeks. Not the worst team in the league

entries.name: Brook
entries.blurb: Terrible ass cheeks start for Brook earns in the 12 spot. Caleb, Mcconkey and AJ brown return soon and Derrick Henry still getting it done... could turn things around but its been a lot of ass so far.
